title_suffix: recertified 1e-10000 supplier endpoint and 1e-10010 slacks (kappa +2.00336e-500 over PR1897): fine source-prime padding (PR1786) at the free epsilon -> 1 point, with gauge-free interiors and the radix-distributed union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-10010 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-10010), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-10010, beta = 1 - 6e-10010, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-10013 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-10010. Endpoint recertification: native and conservative complex endpoints refined to 1e-10000 (accept at endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-10000) with the repaired fine engines evaluated in directed-rounding integer fixed point; kappa exceeds PR1897 by 2.00336e-500, PR1876 by 8.11857e-401, PR1875 by 6.06686e-301 and PR1839 by 6.56133e-91 (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls).
